title: Asking Mary his purpose in the Middle East: "You're here to be here"

tellings.quote: And got back kind of a again, nothing verbal or just a an answer, which was, "You're here to be here."

plain: Sometime between 2011 and 2016, while he was in the Middle East, Ralph Larson asked Mary what he was there for. He got no spoken reply, only an answer that arrived as a knowing: "You're here to be here." Larson, whom the episode presents as a former CIA chief, tells Michels this as his own experience, and he mentions a Jesuit priest friend, whom he does not name, in connection with it.
